channel.title: La Puce Libre — Microcontrôland (English)
channel.description: Microcontrôland's daily paper, written every evening by the gateway.

item.title: Day 46 — Wheat falls 3.0%
item.description: The Fields region watches its income melt away. The rest of the country feels it too.

item.title: Day 45 — Sita leads the poll on 53%
item.description: Voting intentions: Sita 53%, Niwata 35%, Soubaïnath 12%; nobody mentions Houtak, Nakaïk or Saïnaïtaï; of those asked, 3 intend to abstain. 20 citizens drawn by lot were asked at 16:00. At this sample size the margin of error is about 24 points. Readers are invited to bear this in mind, and will not.

item.title: Day 44 — Storm over the City region
item.description: Local output is cut to a third for twelve hours. The weather has not apologised.

item.title: Day 43 — Microcontrôland slides into democracy
item.description: Under President Niwata, the country leaves “Fragile democracy”. The institutions are breathing again. Cautiously.

item.title: Day 42 — Wheat falls 3.7%
item.description: The Fields region watches its income melt away. The rest of the country feels it too.

item.title: Day 41 — Copper falls 5.0%
item.description: The Mines region watches its income melt away. The rest of the country feels it too.

item.title: Day 40 — The street topples President Wibouth
item.description: 50 rebel brains, about 500k inhabitants, have brought down the government. The revolt began in the Refineries region. An election is being held at once, while the mood lasts.

item.title: Breaking — Post-revolution election: Kiti (Harbour) elected with 57%
Breaking — Revolt! President Wibouth toppled by 50 rebel brains (500k inhabitants)
item.description: Revolt! President Wibouth toppled by 50 rebel brains (500k inhabitants)

item.title: Day 39 — Microcontrôland slides into revolutionary unrest
item.description: Under President Wibouth, the country leaves “Fragile democracy”. The situation remains unstable. This is described as stable.

item.title: Day 38 — Microcontrôland slides into fragile democracy
item.description: Under President Wibouth, the country leaves “Democracy”. The situation remains unstable. This is described as stable.

item.title: Day 37 — Wibouth elected president with 37% of the vote
item.description: The new president comes from the Fields region, which becomes the capital. The outgoing president, Niwata, has been defeated, and has noticed. He was once sacked as a minister. This is, in a sense, his reply.
